scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts PetWatchDemo out/pet-watch-demo.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.finalize: ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/pet-watch-demo.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 192k out/pet-watch-demo-final.mp4
scripts.build: npm run render && npm run finalize
